title: Ironhollow Rising Again
author: Jude Kavanagh
blurb: Sable Quintana, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
